#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev, cap;
    Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap) {}
};

class Dinic {
public:
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<int> level;
    vector<int> iter;

    Dinic(int n) : n(n) {
        g.resize(n);
        level.resize(n);
        iter.resize(n);
    }

    void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        Edge fwd(to, g[to].size(), cap);
        Edge rev(from, g[from].size(), 0);
        g[from].push_back(fwd);
        g[to].push_back(rev);
    }

    int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            fill(iter.begin(), iter.end(), 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(s, t, INT_MAX)) > 0) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

private:
    bool bfs(int s, int t) {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        queue<int> q;
        level[s] = 0;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (const Edge& e : g[v]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] >= 0;
    }

    int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        for (; iter[v] < (int)g[v].size(); iter[v]++) {
            Edge& e = g[v][iter[v]];
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] < level[e.to]) {
                int d = dfs(e.to, t, min(f, e.cap));
                if (d > 0) {
                    e.cap -= d;
                    g[e.to][e.rev].cap += d;
                    return d;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    long long ans = 0;

    if (n > 100) {
        int rem = (n - 100) % 6;
        long long q = (n - 100) / 6;
        ans += q * 6LL * m;
        n = 100 + rem;
    }

    if (m > 100) {
        int rem = (m - 100) % 6;
        long long q = (m - 100) / 6;
        ans += q * 6LL * n;
        m = 100 + rem;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> id(n + 1, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
    int even = 1, odd = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (((i + j) & 1) == 0) id[i][j] = even++;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (((i + j) & 1) != 0) id[i][j] = odd++;
        }
    }

    int L = even - 1;
    int R = odd - 1;

    int source = 0;
    int sink = L + R + 1;
    Dinic dinic(sink + 1);

    for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
        dinic.addEdge(source, i, 1);
    }

    auto addFlowEdge = [&](int i, int j, int s, int t) {
        if (s <= 0 || t <= 0 || s > n || t > m) return;
        int left = id[i][j];
        int right = id[s][t];
        dinic.addEdge(left, L + right, 1);
    };

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (((i + j) & 1) == 0) {
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i - 3, j);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i - 2, j - 1);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i - 2, j + 1);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i, j - 3);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i - 1, j - 2);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i + 1, j - 2);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i, j + 3);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i - 1, j + 2);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i + 1, j + 2);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i + 3, j);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i + 2, j - 1);
                addFlowEdge(i, j, i + 2, j + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    for (int r = 1; r <= R; r++) {
        dinic.addEdge(L + r, sink, 1);
    }

    ans += 2LL * dinic.maxFlow(source, sink);
    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
